parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation blade of the knife, made of stainless steel, forming the cutting edge of the object.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main cutting component, rotating or folding into the handle for safety when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot point to open or close, allowing the knife to switch between active and stored states.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid or outer cover of the knife, made of aluminum alloy, providing structural protection and aesthetic finish.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal mechanism and blade when folded, and contributes to the ergonomic grip.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed relative to the base body, enclosing the blade when the knife is closed.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the knife, made of a durable plastic composite, forming the main gripping area.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable and secure grip for the user, housing the blade and pivot mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the structural base for the folding and locking mechanism.
